title: openai-responses: passthrough seed/determinism + metadata + streaming stability fixes
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes:
- Add passthrough of seed / deterministic flags to OpenAI Responses-compatible endpoints.
- Preserve and forward user metadata fields through the compatibility layer.
- Improve streaming frame stability for Responses streaming and function/tool-calling flows.
- Backwards-compatible API behaviour; no client-facing breaking changes.
description:
Context: The OpenAI Responses API variants (newer /responses semantics) are rolling out and customers expect deterministic replay hooks (seed/determinism) and that request metadata is preserved end-to-end. Also, we observed flakiness in long-lived streaming connections when using function/tool calling which caused truncated frames or duplicate finalization events.

Summary: This PR updates the OpenAI-compatibility layer to: 1) accept and forward seed/determinism parameters where supported by the underlying runtime, 2) passthrough the 'metadata' payload from the incoming OpenAI-style request into the internal request context and into audit logs/trace ids, and 3) increase stability of streaming flow for Responses-style streaming including function/tool call handoffs and structured output buffering. Docs and SDK compatibility tests are updated.

What changed (high level): commit list and rationale: - feat: wire seed and deterministic flags through compatibility adapter -> ensures deterministic sampling path is used in serving runtime when requested. - feat: preserve metadata object and add explicit metadata headers to internal RPCs -> allows audit logs, query correlation and eval passthrough. - fix: stabilize streaming frame flush and finalization events for tool-calling handoffs -> prevents truncated tool payloads and double-close race. - test: add integration tests for responses streaming with tool-calling and deterministic seeding. - docs: update openai-compat docs and examples to show seed + metadata usage.

Files touched (high level): - services/openai-compat/adapter.go (seed/determinism mapping, metadata extraction) - services/openai-compat/streaming_handler.go (frame buffering, finalization fixes) - runtime/serving/determinism.go (sampling path switch) - runtime/serving/metadata.go (metadata header support) - integration-tests/responses_streaming_test.go (new tests) - docs/openai/compatibility.md (examples + notes) - sdk/python/examples/responses_seed_metadata.py (usage example) - CHANGELOG.md

Testing / CI: Unit test suite updated (adapter + runtime) and integration test added for end-to-end streaming with a mock tool host. CI: lint -> pass, unit tests -> pass, integration tests -> flaky earlier (streaming test) fixed after adding a short heartbeat and retry on initial frame; all checks green on last run.

Review highlights and discussion: - Liam: requested clearer separation between "seed" semantics and our internal non-deterministic caching; asked for explicit fallback when runtime does not support deterministic seeds. Author: added a runtime capability check and explicit warning in logs when seed request is ignored. - Priya: suggested adding audit log fields for metadata to ease debugging; author: added metadata headers and linked them to existing audit log schema. - Ethan: asked for extra test coverage on tool-calling handoff paths; author: added an integration that exercises a multi-chunk tool payload and asserts no truncation and single close event.

Backward compatibility: The adapter preserves default behavior when seed/determinism is not provided. If underlying runtime does not support deterministic seeds, we log and continue with usual sampling (non-breaking). Metadata passthrough only forwards the provided fields; we do not mutate or enrich customer metadata in this change.

Rollout plan: Feature gated behind openai_compat.experimental_flags.enable_responses_seed_metadata (default: true). We will monitor streaming error rates and audit metadata propagation for 48 hours post-merge; rollback plan is to disable the flag and redeploy adapter service if we observe elevated errors.

Merge: Squash and merge after approvals and CI green.
commits: feat(adapter): passthrough seed/determinism to runtime (Sofia Patel)
feat(adapter): forward metadata object as internal headers
fix(streaming): stabilize frame flush & tool handoff race
test(integration): responses streaming + tool-calling deterministic test
review_comments: Liam: Please add a capability check and clear log if runtime doesn't support deterministic seed. -> Done, added capability check and unit test.
Priya: Add metadata to audit logs for easier correlation. -> Done, metadata headers and audit link implemented.
Ethan: Add an integration covering multi-chunk tool payloads to ensure no truncation. -> Added test and fixed race by introducing single-writer finalizer in stream handler.
ci_checks: e2e-streaming: pass (was flaky, fixed by heartbeat+retry)
notes_for_ops: This change introduces a new runtime capability check and adds two new audit headers (X-RW-Metadata, X-RW-Seed). Ops should ensure the adapter is deployed in the same rollout window as serving runtime update that includes determinism support. Feature flag available to toggle if needed.
changelog_entry: OpenAI compat: passthrough seed/determinism and metadata for Responses endpoints; streaming stability fixes for function/tool calling.
manual_steps: 1) Deploy services/openai-compat to staging; 2) Run integration-tests/responses_streaming_test.go against staging serving; 3) Toggle feature flag if issues detected; 4) Promote to prod when green.
notes: No customer-facing API changes; primarily adapter and runtime plumbing. Observability dashboards updated to track 'responses.seed_ignored' metric.
